p.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(p / 'homemade-compose.yaml').write_text('services:
  coolify:
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    volumes:
      - ./storage/app/homemade/init-setup.sh:/etc/s6-overlay/scripts/init-setup.sh:ro
  vite:
    command: ["npm", "run", "build", "--", "--watch"]
    ports: !reset []
')
p = Path('storage/app/homemade')
p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
f = p / 'init-setup.sh'
f.write_text('#!/command/with-contenv sh
set -eu
cd /var/www/html
mkdir -p storage/framework/cache storage/framework/sessions storage/framework/views storage/logs bootstrap/cache
touch storage/logs/laravel.log
chown -R www-data:www-data storage bootstrap/cache
php artisan migrate --step --force
php artisan dev --init
chown -R www-data:www-data storage bootstrap/cache
')
f.chmod(0o755)
p = Path('.env')
if not p.exists():
    p.write_text(Path('.env.development.example').read_text())

python3 - <<'PY'
import os, base64, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('.env')
values = dict(line.split('=', 1) for line in p.read_text().splitlines() if '=' in line and not line.startswith('#'))
for key in ['APP_URL', 'APP_ENV', 'APP_DEBUG', 'DB_HOST', 'DB_PORT', 'DB_DATABASE', 'DB_USERNAME', 'DB_PASSWORD', 'REDIS_HOST', 'REDIS_PORT', 'PUSHER_PORT', 'PUSHER_SCHEME']:
    if key in os.environ:
        values[key] = os.environ[key]
secret = os.environ['COOLIFY_DEV_SECRET']
values['APP_KEY'] = 'base64:' + base64.b64encode(hashlib.sha256(secret.encode()).digest()).decode()
p.write_text(''.join(key + '=' + value + '\n' for key, value in values.items()))
p.chmod(0o600)
Path('public/hot').unlink(missing_ok=True)
PY
